小米-7518964609581400173.title: 机器人结构工程师
小米-7518964609581400173.description:
1.负责机器人的结构设计工作，对接各功能器件模块、电子、测试等各领域，完成结构设计和性能需求的实现； 
2.负责分配子模块对应的设计工作任务，与机械工程师共同完成模块设计任务； 
3.负责与供应商进行结构定制件工艺可行性检讨，确保工艺可行性；
4.负责制定对应各模块设计标准和check list，并进行迭代和更新； 
5.负责解决机器人项目开发过程中的技术问题（研发、制造、组装、售后）。
小米-7518964609581400173.requirements:
1.本科及以上学历，机械或机电一体化相关专业； 
2.5年以上机器人类、消费电子类设计经验，至少主导过两款产品的整机设计经验，有量产经验；
3.能熟练使用Creo（Pro/E），有复杂曲面的设计能力； 
4.熟悉结构设计、仿真方法、电子、传热学等相关知识和技能，熟悉金属CNC工艺、压铸工艺、注塑模具、注塑工艺及热处理工艺； 
5.有人形机器人等相关设计经验优先； 
6.执行力强、工作认真细致，有强烈的责任心和进取心。

小米-7661989266453334335.title: 机器人结构工程师-灵巧手传动方向
小米-7661989266453334335.description:
1. 负责灵巧手及相关机器人部件结构方案设计与优化；
2. 负责复杂曲面建模及外观结构一体化设计，提高产品工业设计品质； 
3. 推动产品轻量化、小型化及高集成化设计；
4. 负责关键零部件设计、公差分析及装配验证；
5. 与工业设计、电子、算法及工艺团队协同，推动产品设计落地；
6. 配合工艺团队完成DFM优化、试制及量产导入。
小米-7661989266453334335.requirements:
1. 5年以上工作经验，具备机器人传动、消费电子或精密机电产品结构设计经验；
2. 本科以上学历，机械工程相关专业优先；
3. 熟悉注塑、压铸、CNC、钣金等制造工艺，具备DFM/DFA设计能力；
4. 熟练使用solidworks/creo等 3D 建模软件进行零件与装配设计，能独立完成带 GD&T 的 2D 工程图绘制；掌握有限元分析工具（如 ANSYS）及公差分析方法；
5. 熟悉自由曲面、人机接触面及机器人外观件设计，兼顾美观、装配及制造要求。

小米-7677555495989774634.title: 机器人结构工艺专家
小米-7677555495989774634.description:
1.加工工艺规划与制定
依据机器人结构特点和生产规模，制定合理的生产工艺方案，涵盖铸造、锻造、机加工、焊接、装配等工艺环节。
确定各工艺环节的工艺参数和操作规范，编写工艺文件，如工艺流程图、作业指导书等，指导现场生产。
对新工艺、新材料进行研究和试验，推动工艺创新，提高生产效率和产品质量，降低生产成本。
2.样品制作与测试
跟进机器人样品的制作过程，协调解决制作过程中出现的结构和工艺问题，确保样品按时、高质量完成。
参与机器人的装配和调试工作，对样品进行全面的性能测试和结构验证，包括运动精度、负载能力、稳定性等方面的测试。
根据测试结果，分析结构和工艺的不足之处，提出改进方案并进行优化设计。
3.量产支持与持续改进
在机器人量产阶段，提供现场技术支持，解决生产过程中出现的工艺问题，确保生产线的稳定运行。
与生产部门、质量部门密切合作，对产品质量进行监控和分析，持续改进产品的结构和工艺，提高产品的一致性和可靠性。
收集和整理生产过程中的工艺数据，为后续产品的优化升级提供依据。
4.供应商管理
参与机器人零部件供应商的选择和评估工作，对供应商的生产能力、工艺水平和产品质量进行考察。
与供应商沟通协调，确保零部件的供应质量和交货期，解决供应商在生产过程中遇到的技术问题。
对供应商提供的零部件进行入厂检验和验收，保证零部件符合设计要求和质量标准。
小米-7677555495989774634.requirements:
1.学历与专业
本科及以上学历，机械设计制造及其自动化、机械工程、机械电子工程等相关专业。
2.知识与技能
精通机械设计原理和方法，精通机械加工工艺、生产工艺、装配工艺等知识。
熟练掌握常用材料的性能和应用，能够合理选择材料并进行材料工艺性分析。
熟练使用 CAD、SolidWorks、Pro/E 等三维设计软件和 AutoCAD 等二维绘图软件，具备良好的计算机辅助工程（CAE）分析能力。
3.工作经验
具有10年以上机械、消费电子、机器人结构工艺相关工作经验。
4.能力素质
具备较强的创新能力和问题解决能力，能够独立思考并解决机器人结构和工艺方面的复杂问题。
良好的沟通协调能力和团队合作精神，能够与不同专业背景的人员合作完成项目任务。
具备较强的学习能力和责任心，能够快速掌握新知识、新技术，对工作认真负责，注重细节。

小米-7670924118351382825.title: 热仿真工程师-机器人
小米-7670924118351382825.description:
1、作为人形机器人热管理领域专家，主导整机及关键部件的散热系统架构与方案设计，推动热效性能达到业界一流标准，确保机器人在复杂工况下具备卓越的热稳定性、使用寿命与能效表现；
2、全生命周期热管理负责：覆盖需求开发、架构设计、热建模仿真、原型验证、测试与量产各阶段，支撑产品从概念到落地的热管理全流程；
3、架构级热设计与风控：主导整机与关节模组的热管理架构设计，明确技术路线，建立热失效风险评估体系，制定极限工况下的容错方案；
4、热方案开发与集成优化：制定并优化关节等高功率部件的散热方案，涵盖热仿真、实验验证与量产导入；协同机电各专业，推进热设计高度集成；构建标准化热测试体系，闭环解决热失效问题；
5、前沿技术探索与落地：领导新型散热材料与技术的预研与评估，推动其在产品中的工程化应用与专利。
小米-7670924118351382825.requirements:
1、硕士及以上学历，工程热物理、热能与动力工程等相关专业，具备机器人或关节模组等复杂系统热设计项目经验；
2、精通热设计与仿真工具，包括 ANSYS Fluent、Icepak、Flotherm、COMSOL 等，具备 多物理场联合仿真能力，熟练使用 Creo/ProE 等结构设计工具；
3、扎实掌握传热、热力学、流体力学等基础理论，具备应对复杂热问题的建模、分析与系统优化能力；
4、熟悉机器人整机及关节散热系统，具备从架构到实现的 系统级热管理设计能力；
5、具备应对高功率密度及极端工况的工程能力，能够在资源受限环境中推动热设计创新，并为结构、控制与热系统协同设计提供专业支持；
6、思维严谨，动手能力强，具备热设计问题的现场分析、调试及闭环优化能力。

小米-7659317177292245291.title: 硬件&网络设备采购
小米-7659317177292245291.description:
. 算力设备采购全链路管理
- 负责 服务器 / 通用算力服务器整机及核心部件的Source-to-Pay 全流程闭环管理，覆盖需求对齐、寻源策略、询比价与商务谈判、合同签订、订单执行、交付跟进、验收结算全生命周期；
- 保障服务器、网络及配套设备按期、保质、合规交付，支撑资源稳定供给。
2. 市场洞察与成本优化
- 持续跟踪 服务器、网络等核心物料（CPU、HBM/DDR5 内存、企业级存储、高速网卡、光模块、线材耗材等）的市场动态、价格趋势、产能变化及行业政策，定期输出算力供应链行业分析报告；
- 具备逆向 BOM 级成本拆解能力，基于业务体量与市场行情进行成本合理性分析，识别价格异常并提供议价依据；
- 通过战略寻源、多供应商竞争、框架协议谈判等方式，实现采购成本最优。
3. 供应商生态建设与风险管控
- 负责算力设备供应商的开发、准入评估、绩效考核及全生命周期管理，搭建稳定高效的供应商资源池；
- 优化供应结构，提升关键物料（cpu、内存、硬盘）的供应保障能力与风险应对能力；
- 维护与核心供应商的战略合作关系，推动长期供货协议落地，应对供应链波动风险。
4. 采购体系与合规内控建设
- 参与算力采购管理制度、业务流程及合规体系建设与优化，确保采购活动全流程可追溯；
- 推动采购数据沉淀与分析，搭建算力采购成本数据库，为采购策略制定提供数据支撑。
5. 业务协同与跨部门协作
- 深入理解公司 AI / 大模型业务战略，贴近业务一线，探知算力需求痛点；
- 协同业务、运维、财务、法务等部门，制定适配业务发展的采购解决方案。
小米-7659317177292245291.requirements:
（一）基本要求
1. 学历背景：本科及以上学历，计算机、通信、电子工程等工科相关专业优先；
2. 工作经验：4年及以上服务器 / 算力设备采购经验，有互联网、云厂商或 IDC 行业算力采购经验者优先。
（二）核心能力要求
-熟悉服务器整机及核心部件的技术参数、市场行情与供应渠道；具备部件级成本分析与逆向 BOM 拆解能力
-独立承接过大型算力采购项目，熟悉从整机到芯片级的采购全流程；掌握商务谈判、供应商管理、成本控制、合约管理等核心能力
-具备市场洞察与行业分析能力，能基于市场变化制定采购策略；逻辑清晰，善于用数据发现并解决复杂问题
-有采购流程标准化、成本数据库搭建或采购数字化转型经验者优先
（三）软技能与职业素养
- 良好的沟通协调能力与跨部门协作能力，能高效推进复杂项目落地；
- 诚信正直，责任心强，具备较强的合规意识与风险管控意识；
- 积极主动，贴近业务，具备较强的业务理解能力与需求转化能力；

小米-7626304383269013796.title: 硬件结构工程师
小米-7626304383269013796.description:
1. 负责油烟机整机结构方案设计、三维建模、二维工程图绘制，主导新品从概念设计到量产的全流程结构开发。
2. 开展油烟机运动机构设计、仿真验证与优化，保障机构运行稳定性、可靠性与使用寿命。
3. 攻克排烟效率、降噪、密封、结构运动卡顿等技术痛点，解决研发、试产、量产中的结构技术问题。
4. 优化现有产品结构，实现产品升级、成本管控与轻量化改进，提升产品综合竞争力。
5. 编制BOM清单、设计规范、测试方案等技术文档，把控研发各节点交付质量。
6. 协同跨部门完成样机试制、测试认证、生产落地，配合专利申报与技术攻关。
7. 跟踪行业前沿技术、新材料新工艺，调研竞品结构，推进结构技术创新。
小米-7626304383269013796.requirements:
1. 本科及以上学历，机械设计、机电一体化等相关专业，扎实掌握机械设计理论。
2. 8年及以上家电结构设计经验，5年以上油烟机专职结构设计经验，独立主导过油烟机量产项目。
3. 熟练使用Creo、CAD等设计软件，精通运动机构设计、仿真分析及落地验证。
4. 熟悉钣金、注塑、模具加工工艺，掌握家电安规、可靠性测试及结构设计标准。
5. 具备较强的结构优化、问题排查解决能力，良好的项目推进与跨部门沟通能力。
6. 熟悉油烟机工作原理，有产品运动机构设计、高端厨电结构设计经验者优先。
7. 责任心强，注重产品设计落地性与用户体验。

小米-7559846020377545014.title: 自动驾驶与机器人VLA实习生
小米-7559846020377545014.description:
1.前沿算法研究与构建：负责设计和实现领先的具身多模态大模型。您的研究将不仅限于现有的VLA框架，更将探索如何构建能够理解复杂三维世界、并进行长时序、多步骤任务规划的世界模型 (World Model)。
2. 核心模型能力攻关：主导模型在以下关键能力上的突破：多模态场景理解：融合视觉、语言、雷达等多源信息，实现对动态、开放环境的深刻理解和空间感知。
复杂语义推理与决策：让模型能够理解模糊、抽象的人类指令，并结合对物理世界的空间推理，生成安全、合理、可解释的行动序列。
3. 学习与适应机制：深入研究强化学习 (RL)、模仿学习 (IL) 及自监督学习方法，使模型能从海量数据和与环境的交互中持续学习和进化。
4.技术愿景与路线图：主导构建可泛化、高效率的具身智能基座模型，为未来1-3年的技术演进提供核心支撑，并探索其在自动驾驶和通用机器人领域的统一应用潜力。
5.学术影响力与合作：与全球顶尖高校及研究机构合作，探索表征学习、因果推理、世界模型等长期议题。在CVPR、NeurIPS、ICLR、CoRL等顶级会议上发表高水平论文，构建团队的学术护城河。
小米-7559846020377545014.requirements:
候选人需在以下一个或多个领域具备深入的研究和实践经验：
1.编程与算法能力：精通Python，熟练使用至少一种主流深度学习框架（优先考虑PyTorch）。具备强大的算法设计与实现能力，能够处理大规模数据并高效进行模型训练。
2. 多模态大模型：深入理解视觉语言模型（VLM）和视觉-语言-行动模型（VLA），具备从零到一构建或优化这些模型的实践经验。
3. 具身智能与自动驾驶：优先考虑有复现具身智能和自动驾驶相关视觉语言模型（VLM）和视觉语言架构（VLA）经验的候选人。
4.科研能力：作为主要作者在CVPR、ICCV、ECCV、ICML、NeurIPS、ICLR、CoRL等顶级会议上发表过高质量论文，或在相关领域的权威竞赛中取得优异成绩。对科研有热情，励志做有影响力的工作优先。

小米-7552814019373418815.description:

1. 根据芯片的规格和设计信息制定芯片的可靠性测试方案；
2. 负责可靠性测试硬件设计和老化向量调试；

3.熟悉可靠性测试工作，包括但不限于HTOL测试、package qual等，有可靠性测试方案制定、BIB设计、向量开发、老化测试机台调试经验者优先；
4.掌握芯片失效机理，熟悉芯片FA流程，有熟练使用不同FA手段、快速定位失效问题经验者优先；
5.有HVS\Burn in量产经验优先；

小米-7651437116367587611.title: 车身区域控制器系统开发工程师（偏硬件方向）
小米-7651437116367587611.description:
1. 系统需求管理：拆解整车级、系统级需求，转化为车身区域系统需求，重点负责硬件相关需求定义（电源、IO、通讯接口、负载驱动、硬件保护等），满足整车规范、功能安全、法规及项目目标；管理需求评审、需求变更、版本基线发布。
2. 车身区域控制器系统架构与接口设计：负责区域控制器跨子系统集成，对接车身、底盘、动力VCU、热管理系统；定义硬件交互接口、线束接口。
3. 硬件系统方案评审：参与原理图、器件选型评审，从系统维度评估硬件方案可行性、负载匹配、功耗、散热、EMC、硬件故障诊断策略；输出系统层面硬件设计约束、DFMEA分析。
4. 跨团队协同：协调硬件、嵌入式软件、测试工程师，推进需求落地，定位系统级问题（软硬件交互、接口不匹配、负载异常、供电异常等），推动闭环整改。
5. 风险识别与管控：识别系统设计中硬件相关潜在风险（整车供电、负载、温度、干扰、单点失效），制定缓解策略，保障产品可靠性、功能安全。
6. 评审组织：组织内外部需求评审、系统方案评审，输出系统规范、接口规范、测试规范等文档，支撑标定、验证工作。
小米-7651437116367587611.requirements:
1. 学历：本科及以上，电子工程、自动化、电气工程、车辆工程等相关专业。
2. 经验：5年及以上汽车Tier1或主机厂车身域控平台系统或硬件开发经验。
3. 熟悉汽车电子硬件基础：模拟和数字电路基础，了解车载电源、IO驱动、CAN/LIN/Ethernet车载通讯，熟悉EMC、车载环境可靠性要求；能看懂原理图，可独立评估硬件系统方案。
4. 熟悉整车电子电气架构，熟悉车身系统，了解底盘、VCU、热管理等相关子系统工作原理，清楚各部件和车身域控的硬件交互逻辑。
5. 熟悉汽车开发流程：FMEA（DFMEA）、需求工程、V模型开发；了解功能安全ISO26262优先。
6. 熟练使用需求管理工具（Doors），具备需求拆解、追溯、变更管理经验。 
7. 优秀跨部门沟通协调能力，可对接专业团队推进问题闭环。
8. 良好风险识别、问题分析能力，擅长定位软硬件耦合类系统问题。
9. 严谨的文档撰写能力，能够输出系统需求、接口规范、设计方案等。

优先加分项
1. 有左右区域控制器、车身域控量产项目经验。
2. 具备硬件开发背景，独立负责过车载控制器硬件开发。
3. 熟悉车载功能安全ISO26262，ASIL-B及以上项目经验。
4. 熟悉车载线束、负载管理、电源分配、热管理系统集成。

小米-7703557805185960234.title: 通信芯片低功耗架构专家
小米-7703557805185960234.description: 负责 5G/6G 蜂窝通信芯片的低功耗架构与系统级功耗优化，制定功耗预算、电源与时钟方案，推动低功耗设计从架构定义、实现验证、通信低功耗软硬件调优全流程落地，确保芯片在性能、功耗、面积和时序之间达成目标。
小米-7703557805185960234.requirements:
基本要求
1. 计算机、通信、电子信息、微电子等相关专业，具备 10 年以上数字芯片或 SoC 领域工作经验，其中 5 年以上低功耗架构或设计经验。
2. 熟悉芯片功耗分析与优化，具备系统级功耗预算、建模和量化分析能力，能够使用 C/C++、SystemC 或 Python 开展功耗评估。
3. 熟悉多电源域、时钟门控、DVFS、Retention、Power Gating 等低功耗技术，具备电源域、时钟及低功耗状态切换的架构设计经验。
4. 熟悉数字芯片设计与实现流程，理解 RTL、综合、时序分析、低功耗验证及后端实现约束，能够推动功耗目标在设计和实现阶段收敛。
5. 熟悉 5G NR 通信系统及 Modem 主要模块，能够结合协议流程、业务场景和数据通路特征识别功耗优化机会。
6. 具备从架构定义到量产的项目经验，以及技术规范编写、需求管理和跨团队协作能力。
加分项
1. 主导过 5G NR Modem、通信 ASIC 或复杂 SoC 的低功耗架构设计及量产项目，具备功耗分析和优化闭环经验。
2. 熟悉低功耗仿真或形式验证，以及功耗分析和物理实现相关 EDA 工具。
3. 具备多模多卡、载波聚合、高吞吐数据通路等复杂场景下的功耗与性能协同优化经验。
4. 具备先进制程 SoC、低功耗 IP 集成、功耗分析工具建设，或 6G、AI for PHY 等新型通信架构功耗规划经验。

8.支持芯片从流片到量产阶段的测试调试，定位并解决硅片问题(Silicon Debug)；
9. 跟踪先进工艺节点(7nm/5nm/3nm及以下)下模拟电路的设计挑战与技术趋势。

2.扎实的模拟电路设计基础，深入理解运放、比较器、带隙基准、LDO等基本模块；

-高速CTLE/VGA/DFE模拟前端
-高速ADC (SAR/ Pipeline/TI-ADC，采样率≥ 4GS/s)
-高速时钟电路(VCO/PI/DLL)
4.熟练使用Cadence Virtuoso、Spectre、Calibre等EDA工具;
5.具备混合信号仿真能力，能进行系统级建模与性能评估;
6.良好的英文技术文档阅读和沟通能力。

小米-7688908073369045289.title: 高级PCS嵌入式软件开发工程师
小米-7688908073369045289.description:
1. 整体软件架构搭建：负责户用混合光储一体机PCS软件整体架构设计、任务优先级规划、中断调度体系搭建，制定软件分层规范、代码规范、调试规范，搭建可迭代的PCS软件平台。
2. 核心控制算法自研：独立开发双向DC/DC升降压闭环控制、DC/AC并网逆变、离网Vf稳压、PQ恒功率控制、MPPT光伏最大功率追踪等核心电力电子算法，保障系统转换效率、运行稳定性。
3. 关键功能开发落地：负责并离网无缝切换（≤10ms）、软硬件双重防孤岛、低电压穿越、电网适应性控制等并网核心功能开发，适配VDE、AS、GB等海内外主流并网标准。
4. EMS 能量管理系统开发：开发 PCS 内部硬实时 EMS 能量调度内核：实时汇总光伏功率、负载功率、电网功率、BMS 充放电功率限值，完成毫秒级功率平衡仲裁；实现光伏自用优先、防反向送电、故障功率紧急限制等安全调度逻辑。 对接 IoT/HMI 团队：接收 APP、触摸屏、云端下发的 EMS 策略参数（SOC 上下限、工作模式、峰谷时段配置），在 PCS 本地完成策略解析与执行；
5. 光储协同与能量调度：负责PCS与BMS的CAN通信交互、功率指令仲裁、电池功率限值适配，开发EMS本地能量调度策略，实现光伏自用、峰谷套利、负荷最优匹配等核心业务逻辑。
6. 系统状态机与保护逻辑：设计PCS整机全流程状态机（待机-自检-并网-离网-限流-告警-故障保护），完善过压、过流、过载、电网异常、通信失效等故障保护与容错机制。
7. 产品迭代与量产支撑：负责PCS固件OTA升级、日志管理、故障诊断功能开发，配合硬件完成功率环路调试、EMC优化、高低温老化测试，支撑产品认证、试产及量产迭代。
8. 技术攻关与方案优化：解决并网震荡、切换冲击、功率不稳、谐波超标等行业核心问题，迭代优化控制算法，提升产品效率、稳定性与兼容性。
小米-7688908073369045289.requirements:
1. 本科及以上学历、电力电子、自动化、电气工程等相关专业，5年以上户储混合逆变器PCS软件研发经验，有5~15kW户用光储一体机量产经验优先。
2. 精通TI DSP（F280049/F28335）或STM32H7/GD32H7高端MCU开发，熟练掌握嵌入式实时中断、任务调度、定时器配置，精通C语言。
3. 扎实掌握电力电子核心理论，熟练掌握双向Buck-Boost、全桥逆变拓扑控制逻辑，精通PI闭环、MPPT、锁相环、并离网切换核心算法。
4. 具备储能 EMS 能量管理内核开发经验，理解功率分层调度机制；能够独立实现光、储、负荷、电网四者功率平衡策略。
5. 熟悉储能系统整体架构，精通PCS与BMS CAN通信交互机制，熟练处理光储协同、功率匹配、故障联动等整机逻辑。
6. 熟悉海内外户储并网标准，具备并网调试、电网适应性优化、谐波抑制、防孤岛功能开发落地经验。
7. 具备独立架构设计、问题攻关能力，可独立完成从算法仿真、代码开发、整机联调到量产落地的全流程工作。
8. 有SiC器件控制、多机并联、UPS不间断电源开发经验者优先，有行业头部企业工作经验优先。

小米-7707479786809035062.title: 高级SOC芯片系统工程师（系统安全方向）
小米-7707479786809035062.description:
1. 负责安全隔离架构设计，输出SLC安全及总线一致性安全等方案，实现安全世界硬件隔离；
2. 负责虚拟化隔离架构设计，实现虚拟化机密环境隔离及子系统硬件直通方案；
3. 负责芯片级安全业务设计，包括DRM、隐私安全方案、安全存储等；
4. 负责安全子系统的架构设计，输出规格方案，统筹特性落地路径；
5. 参与安全需求分析与安全规格制定，将业务安全需求转化为可实现的硬件安全架构方案；
6. 负责安全方案的验证与评估，包括安全攻击测试、侧信道分析等，确保安全方案满足目标安全等级要求；
7. 跨团队协作，与软件安全、Firmware、验证、IP供应商及合规团队紧密协作，确保安全方案的完整落地；
8. 参与芯片安全技术及业务整体规划。
小米-7707479786809035062.requirements:
1. 微电子、信息安全、电子工程、计算机等相关专业本科及以上学历；
2. 具备6年及以上SoC/芯片安全架构或系统架构相关经验，有完整流片项目经验优先；
3. 具备ARM TrustZone、虚拟化安全架构设计经验，熟悉Secure Boot链、密钥管理等安全业务流程；
4. 熟悉密码学原理及常见密码引擎（AES、RSA、SHA、ECC等）的硬件实现方案；
5. 熟悉业界攻击手段（软件侧信道、硬件侧信道、故障注入等）及其硬件防护措施，具备安全攻击分析或安全评估实践经验；
6. 了解安全认证标准（如CC EAL、FIPS 140等），具备相关认证落地经验者优先；
7. 熟悉安全威胁建模（如STRIDE）及安全风险评估方法；
8. 具备良好的跨团队沟通能力，能有效推动安全特性从架构设计到流片验证的完整落地。

小米-7694137463598336294.title: 高级嵌入式软件开发工程师
小米-7694137463598336294.description:
1. 负责 Qualcomm、MTK 平台 Modem 软件的集成、开发、调试和维护，主要面向车载通信产品。
2. 负责 Modem 与系统软件之间的接口适配，包括 Qualcomm RIL/Vendor HAL、MTK Telephony/RIL Framework、Qualcomm QMI/MBIM 以及 MTK Modem 接口和协议适配。
3. 负责蜂窝网络相关功能开发，包括 SIM/eSIM 卡管理、搜网注册、网络状态管理、LTE/NR 制式切换、数据链路建立与恢复、VoLTE/VoNR 通话、DSDA 双卡双待、短信及数据业务等。
4. 负责 Modem 异常问题定位和恢复机制开发，处理 Modem 异常重启、掉网、无法注册、数据断链、通话失败、网络切换异常、开机初始化及休眠唤醒等问题。
5. 负责车载通信性能和稳定性优化，包括网络连接稳定性、吞吐率、时延、弱信号、LTE/NR 切换、多运营商适配及 DSDA 场景下的通信资源协调。
6. 使用 Qualcomm QXDM、QCAT、QPST、Modem Log，以及 MTK Modem Log、META、MOL、Kernel Log、Android Log 等工具进行问题复现、日志分析和故障定位。
7. 负责 Modem 版本集成、软件测试、问题闭环、版本发布及技术文档编写
8. 具备网联产品软件开发经验；
小米-7694137463598336294.requirements:
1. 本科及以上学历，计算机、通信、电子信息、自动化等相关专业。
2. 具备 3 年及以上 Linux 嵌入式、T-Box、TCU的Modem部分相关开发经验。
3. 熟悉 C/C++，具备 Linux 用户空间、内核或驱动开发经验，熟悉进程、线程、Socket、IPC、文件系统及常用调试方法。
4. 熟悉 Qualcomm 或 MTK 平台中的至少一种，具备 Modem 软件集成和问题定位能力；熟悉 RIL/Vendor HAL、QMI/MBIM、Telephony Framework 等相关技术者优先。
5. 熟悉蜂窝通信基本原理和相关功能，了解 SIM/eSIM、网络注册、搜网、LTE/5G 制式切换、数据链路、VoLTE/VoNR 或 DSDA 等功能。
6. 具备较强的日志分析、问题复现、故障定位和跨团队沟通能力，能够独立完成问题从复现、分析到修复验证的闭环。
7. 熟悉 Git、GDB、CMake/Make 等开发和构建工具，具备良好的代码规范和文档编写能力。
8. 具有车载通信产品、T-Box/TCU、Qualcomm/MTK 平台量产项目经验者优先。

小米-7506718982197297261.title: 高级机器人热管理工程师
小米-7506718982197297261.description:
1. 作为人形机器人热管理领域专家，主导整机及关键部件的散热系统架构与方案设计，推动热效性能达到业界一流标准，确保机器人在复杂工况下具备卓越的热稳定性、使用寿命与能效表现；
2. 全生命周期热管理负责：覆盖需求开发、架构设计、热建模仿真、原型验证、测试与量产各阶段，支撑产品从概念到落地的热管理全流程；
3. 架构级热设计与风控：主导整机与关节模组的热管理架构设计，明确技术路线，建立热失效风险评估体系，制定极限工况下的容错方案；
4. 热方案开发与集成优化：制定并优化关节等高功率部件的散热方案，涵盖热仿真、实验验证与量产导入；协同机电各专业，推进热设计高度集成；构建标准化热测试体系，闭环解决热失效问题；
5. 前沿技术探索与落地：领导新型散热材料与技术的预研与评估，推动其在产品中的工程化应用与专利布局。
小米-7506718982197297261.requirements:
1. 硕士及以上学历，工程热物理、热能与动力工程等相关专业，具备 3 年以上机器人或关节模组等复杂系统热设计经验；
2. 精通热设计与仿真工具，包括 ANSYS Fluent、Icepak、Flotherm、COMSOL 等，具备 多物理场联合仿真能力，熟练使用 Creo/ProE 等结构设计工具；
3. 扎实掌握热力学、流体力学等基础理论，具备应对复杂热问题的建模、分析与系统优化能力；
4. 熟悉机器人整机及关节散热系统，具备从架构到实现的系统级热管理设计能力；
5. 具备应对高功率密度及极端工况的工程能力，能够在资源受限环境中推动热设计创新，并为结构、控制与热系统协同设计提供专业支持；
6. 思维严谨，动手能力强，具备热设计问题的现场分析、调试及闭环优化能力；
7. 有发表过热管理领域顶刊论文，有人形机器人等复杂系统的热管理项目经验优先。

小米-7626673685194033414.title: 3D Creative Artist – Design Visualization
小米-7626673685194033414.description:
What you'll do (Responsibilities)

1.Create creative visual productions (stills, animations and films) that communicate design intent and give our designs presence in key reviews and presentations
2.Produce high-quality evaluation renderings of interior, exterior and CMF design proposals
3.Prepare and optimize data for VR design reviews in VRED, and support those reviews on the day
4.Composite and finish animations in After Effects or DaVinci Resolve
5.Work side by side with interior, exterior and CMF designers to understand their intent and translate it into visuals
6.Help develop and maintain our digital material library.
6.Help develop AI-assisted visualization pipelines, from testing new tools to integrating them into daily work
7.Keep scenes, assets and files clean, organized and consistent with team pipelines and naming conventions
小米-7626673685194033414.requirements:
What you bring (Experience)

1.Minimum 2 years of professional experience in automotive 3D CG visualization
2.A portfolio that shows strong creative work: composition and storytelling.
3.Solid hands-on skills in VRED and Blender
4.Experience preparing data and scenes for VR reviews in VRED
5.Compositing and editing skills in After Effects or DaVinci Resolve
6.A good understanding of visualization pipelines, data handling and file organization across tools
7.Curiosity about AI tools and how they can improve creative and production workflows
8.Clear communication with designers and the ability to take and give feedback
9.Fluent English

Nice to have

1.Experience with Unreal Engine for real-time visualization and cinematics
2.Experience with photography, film or motion design outside of automotive
3.Hands-on work with generative AI tools in a production context

How to apply
Please send your CV together with a portfolio or showreel. Show us the creative work you are most proud of, and tell us briefly what your role was in each piece.

小米-7678595096846272804.description:
工作内容：
1、品类业务计划执行实现：根据确定的策略和计划，协调产研/销服体系资源实现业务目标达成，包括货品要货/分发；
2、产品规划：负责面向消费者的产品策略和计划落地，包括品类产品渠道匹配协调、价格规划、人群定位规划：

5、新品上市：对新品上市的收入、费率负责，对新品的销售贡献占比负责；
6、需求管理：从产品/渠道角度收集并反馈客户、KOL、消费者的需求，推动对应部门落地需求实现

小米-7681153350842779913.title: AIOT GTM产品经理（大家电）
小米-7681153350842779913.description:
负责大家电品类业务操盘
1. 市场和消费者洞察：分析市场及竞争情况，总结研究，并输出市场策略。对市场、行业、竞争对手，消费者开展调研和洞察，收集宏观市场、行业（含客户/渠道）、消费者和竞争数据，输出有价值的洞察分析报告。
2. 产品拓展：独立负责产品的GTM工作，进行4P维度的产品上市操盘，包括产品上市计划、产品进度监督、产品样机、要货预测、价格制定等工作的开展。围绕市场和消费者洞察，牵引产品规划/定义、产品卖点挖掘和包装，制定全球/区域/国家维度的产品解决方案、策略和拓展包。
3. 产品经营与操盘：管理单产品&产品组合经营。基于产品上市操盘的基本流程，根据市场动态，制定/管理营销策略、价格策略、要货预测和渠道库存等组合策略，促进产品盈利。
4. 项目管理：对产品生命周期的全过程管理，监控市场销售情况，针对市场情况开展调价、控货等策略调整，对产品的商业成功负责，负责产品端到端的生命周期项目管理。基于项目目标，制定合理计划；监控项目执行，牵引各领域高效投入，快速识别风险并调整资源配置；组织复盘并总结经验，快速改进并推广应用。
小米-7681153350842779913.requirements:
1. 本科及以上学历，五年及以上电子消费品行业工作经验（能力优秀者年限可放宽）
2. 对电子消费品相关产品有浓厚兴趣并能形成自己独到的认知和见解。
3. 具有公开市场产品上市操盘经验，有渠道管理/产品营销或价格策略制定相关从业经验者优先。
4. 具备良好的市场拓展和项目管理能力，有为客户提供产品解决方案的成功案例。
5. 英文流利，可作为工作语言。较强的文化适应性和独立工作的能力。
6. 较强的内外部沟通技巧，目标驱动，结果导向。

小米-7703856401198582054.title: After-Sales Commercial & Partnerships Manager (Charging)
小米-7703856401198582054.description:
欧洲充电与能源经理 European Charging & Energy Manager
工作地点：德国 · 慕尼黑

岗位职责

生态合作与商务拓展（核心）：制定欧洲充电与能源合作策略，主动开发并深度经营 MSP（移动服务提供商）、CPO（充电运营商）、电力公司、能源服务商及能源聚合商等关键伙伴。独立承担从线索挖掘、商务谈判、合作模式与商务条款设计，到协议签署与落地的全流程。核心目标：签约战略合作伙伴、打通欧洲充电网络与能源生态、推动合作收入（分成/GMV）增长。
跨国协同与落地推动：作为欧洲市场与国内产品、研发团队的核心枢纽，牵引资源完成合作项目的技术联调与上线，确保商务承诺如期兑现（充电网络互联互通、动态电价、智能充电、V2G/V2H 及家充业务）。
合作项目经营管理：负责已签约项目的运营与经营分析，对合作收入、网络覆盖、充电成功率与用户体验等核心指标负责，持续挖掘 upsell 与扩展机会。
市场与政策洞察：跟踪欧洲充电与能源市场格局、竞争动态及政策法规变化，识别合作机会与合规风险，为业务决策提供输入。

任职要求

本科及以上学历，具备新能源汽车充电、能源电力或汽车出海相关工作经验。
熟悉欧洲充电与能源生态，拥有 MSP、CPO、电力公司或能源聚合商等合作资源与成功签约案例者优先。
5 年以上商务拓展或合作伙伴管理经验，具备出色的商务谈判、合同起草与跨国项目管理能力，能独立推动复杂项目走完"洽谈到上线运营"全流程。
了解 OCPI、OCPP、ISO 15118 等充电互联标准，理解动态电价、智能充电、V2G/V2H 等业务逻辑（无需深度技术背景）。
英语作为工作语言，具备跨文化商务沟通与影响力；
English Version (Business-Oriented)

European Charging & Energy Manager
Location: Munich, Germany

Key Responsibilities

Ecosystem & Business Development (Primary Focus): Define the European charging and energy partnership strategy; proactively develop and deepen relationships with key players including MSPs (Mobility Service Providers), CPOs (Charge Point Operators), utilities, energy service providers, and energy aggregators. Own the full deal cycle end-to-end — from lead generation and commercial negotiation to partnership model and terms design, contract execution, and post-signing activation. Core objectives: sign strategic partners, unlock charging network and energy ecosystem integration across Europe, and drive partnership revenue growth (revenue share / GMV).
Cross-Border Delivery: Act as the key bridge between European partners and China-based product and R&D teams, driving internal resources to complete technical integration and go-live on schedule — ensuring commercial commitments are delivered (network interoperability, dynamic pricing, smart charging, V2G/V2H, and home charging business).
Partnership Operations & P&L Awareness: Oversee post-launch operations and business analysis for signed partnerships; take ownership of key metrics including partnership revenue, network coverage, charging success rate, and user experience; continuously identify upsell and expansion opportunities.
Market & Regulatory Intelligence: Monitor the European charging and energy landscape — market structure, competitive dynamics, policy and regulatory changes — to identify opportunities and compliance risks, and inform business decisions.
小米-7703856401198582054.requirements:
Requirements

Bachelor's degree or above; experience in EV charging, energy/power sector, or international expansion of automotive businesses.
Strong familiarity with the European charging and energy ecosystem; existing network with MSPs, CPOs, utilities, or energy aggregators, backed by a track record of closed deals, is a strong plus.
5+ years of experience in business development or partnership management; proven skills in commercial negotiation, contract drafting, and cross-border project management, with the ability to take complex projects end-to-end — from first engagement through launch and operations.
Solid understanding of charging interoperability standards (OCPI, OCPP, ISO 15118) and business logic of dynamic pricing, smart charging, and V2G/V2H (deep technical background not required).
Business-level English proficiency with strong cross-cultural communication and influencing skills;

小米-7695729201379330340.description:
1. 负责CPA买量业务的整体策略规划与执行，承接广告主推广预算，深入理解客户行业特征、推广目标（拉新/拉活/促转化）及效果考核要求，制定整体投放策略与预算分配方案。

4. 建立并完善投放数据监控体系，实时跟踪CPA、CVR、ROI、LTV等核心指标，基于数据洞察推动投放策略迭代，持续降低获客成本、提升转化效率。
5. 搭建业务分析模型与复盘机制，定期输出行业洞察报告、竞对投放分析、渠道效果评估，为业务决策提供数据支撑。

2. 统筹多渠道投放策略，根据客户目标与预算规模，平衡CPA成本与量级目标，分配各渠道投放策略制定、预算分配与效果优化。
3. 深度参与买量策略制定、制定采量规则、结算规则，监控各渠道流量质量与采买成本，识别异常波动并快速响应，通过调价、换素材、调定向等手段控制CPA成本，保障投放利润空间。
4. 建立并完善投放数据监控体系，实时跟踪CPA、CVR、ROI、LTV等核心指标，基于数据洞察推动投放策略迭代，持续降低获客成本、提升转化效率。
5. 搭建业务分析模型与复盘机制，定期输出行业洞察报告、竞对投放分析、渠道效果评估，为业务决策提供数据支撑。

1. 本科及以上学历，5年以上效果广告相关经验。
2. 熟悉效果广告投放逻辑，精通厂商广告者加分。
3. 具备扎实的数据分析能力，能拆解投放数据，发现问题并制定可落地的优化策略，推动广告效果提升。
4. 良好的沟通协调能力，能高效对接代理商及内部跨部门团队，推动项目落地与问题解决。
5. 对行业动态与平台新玩法敏感，具备探索欲和钻研精神，有韧性且目标感强。
加分项
- 有厂商广告外投渠道体系搭建、规模化CPA买量操盘经验优先。

小米-7690417782875949354.title: CPA渠道销售
小米-7690417782875949354.description:
岗位职责
1. 负责CPA效果广告业务的代理商全生命周期管理，开发新预算源，聚焦效果类广告主预算承接，完成既定销售业绩目标。
2. 深入了解客户行业特征与营销目标，联合运营为客户制定CPA业务政策和规则，提供一站式效果营销解决方案。
3. 独立完成商务谈判、合同签订与项目推进全流程，确保合作条款清晰、权责明确，推动项目高效落地。
4. 实时跟踪客户投放效果，主动回访与效果反馈，基于数据表现向客户提出优化建议，推动客户消耗持续增长。
5. 洞察行业市场动态与竞品策略变化，收集客户需求与市场反馈，为公司产品优化与业务拓展提供信息支持。
6. 协同内部运营、产品、技术等团队，确保客户需求高效响应与项目顺利交付，推动跨部门协作流程优化。
小米-7690417782875949354.requirements:
1. 本科及以上学历，5年以上互联网广告销售或客户管理经验，有效果广告（CPA/CPC/CPM）业务经验者优先。
2. 熟悉移动互联网广告行业，了解主流广告投放平台（巨量引擎、腾讯广告、厂商应用商店等）的基本业务模式与产品能力。
3. 具备优秀的商务沟通与谈判能力，能独立对接客户中高层，准确理解客户需求并转化为可执行的投放方案。
4. 结果导向，具备使命感与自驱力，能适应快节奏、多任务的工作环境。
5. 坚守商业道德底线 ，严格遵守公司合规制度与行业法规，在业务全流程中保持廉洁自律，杜绝任何形式的商业贿赂、利益输送或收受不当利益行为，维护公司品牌声誉与客户信任基础。
加分项
1. 具备较强的客户开拓与关系维护能力，有存量客户资源或行业人脉者优先。
2. 具备敏锐的行业与客户需求洞察力，能够主动跟踪市场动态，识别潜在合作机会，提前布局并制定差异化的客户开发与维护策略，实现从“被动响应需求”到“主动创造价值”的转变。

小米-7690761452894161188.title: Channel Finance BP （CDI）
小米-7690761452894161188.description:
1.Responsible for end-to-end financial process management at the national level for channels, including channel transaction management, budgeting, ledger maintenance, settlement, reconciliation, accounting treatment, as well as the construction and analysis of key business performance profit and loss models for channels.
2.Gain an in-depth understanding of and participate in channel business processes, including developing independent insights into channel business operations; summarize current channel business scenarios at the national level and standardize them according to headquarters requirements.
3. Adapt headquarters' channel-related financial processes to the national level based on current business scenarios, identify risk points in national-level processes, and develop improvement plans.
4. Execute HQ system implementation plans at the national level.
小米-7690761452894161188.requirements:
1. Bachelor's degree or above in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
2. Preferably experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
3. Proficient in office software, especially Excel.
4. Strong numerical sensitivity with excellent problem identification and resolution skills
5. Responsible, strong communication skills, goal-oriented, with excellent analytical and summarization abilities 
6. Fluent in English and Chinese. Proficiency in French is a plus

小米-7592512714876078363.title: Construction Project Management Manager, Germany
小米-7592512714876078363.description:
Responsibilities
1. Assist the China headquarters in formulating the construction plan for the stores of the German Delivery Center, including the formulation of project schedules, cost budgets, quality standards and compliance plans, ensuring full compliance with Germany's construction qualification classification requirements and environmental protection standards.
2. Be responsible for the full-life-cycle execution of the project, coordinate external partners such as design units, construction parties and supervision institutions, strictly control the construction progress, project quality and safety specifications, and efficiently handle on-site emergencies.
3. Participate in the full-process contract management of the project, including organizing bidding work, selecting high-quality suppliers, promoting contract negotiations and supervising performance; strictly control the compliance of subcontract management, avoid the risk of illegal subcontracting; optimize the supply chain configuration based on the practical experience of Sino-German cooperative projects, and improve resource utilization efficiency.
4. Coordinate the project cost control and risk management work, regularly conduct progress reports and cost accounting, establish and improve a risk early warning mechanism, formulate response plans and report to the Engineering Headquarters in a timely manner; focus on preventing compliance difference risks and cultural adaptation risks in the context of Sino-German cooperation.
5. Serve as the core contact person between the Chinese team and local German institutions, be responsible for communication and coordination with relevant units such as the Federal Institute for Research on Building, Urban Affairs and Spatial Development (BBSR), local municipal departments and energy agencies, ensuring that the project fully complies with Germany's relevant legal requirements such as labor protection, environmental protection and data security.
小米-7592512714876078363.requirements:
Requirements
1. A composite project management talent with local German construction project management experience and practical experience in Sino-German cooperative projects, who deeply understands EU and German engineering compliance standards and can efficiently coordinate the construction of Xiaomi Auto Delivery Center stores.
2. Bachelor's degree or above, majoring in Engineering Management, Architectural Engineering, Civil Engineering or other related disciplines; Priority is given to those holding the Dipl.-Ing. title certified by the German Association of Engineers (VDI), or possessing relevant professional qualifications such as DGNB energy-saving certification and TÜV industrial building audit. Must hold German Registered Structural Engineer (Dipl.-Ing. Bauingenieur) certification or Project Manager (PMP/IPMA) certification.
3. More than 5 years of project management experience in German commercial construction projects, having led at least 2 or more construction projects of commercial stores or similar formats, and familiar with the entire process from site selection and preparation to completion and delivery; 
Priority is given to those with more than 3 years of collaborative management experience in Sino-German cooperative projects or construction projects of Chinese-funded enterprises in Germany, who can accurately adapt to the differences in working models between Chinese and German enterprises and are good at establishing collaborative mechanisms between the two parties.
4. Proficient in the German Construction Act and additional construction clauses of each state, and master core skills such as engineering bidding and tendering, contract management, cost control, and risk management; Possess digital project management capabilities and master German labor protection standards and safety management specifications. 
Priority: Good at integrating resources and aligning needs between China and Germany, with mature experience in technology transfer, supply chain coordination and compliance risk avoidance in cross-cultural projects.
5. Native German or fluent working proficiency; English can be used as a working language; 
Priority is given to those with fluent Chinese communication skills, who can accurately connect with local German suppliers, regulatory authorities and Chinese teams.

小米-7597999480836147466.description:

小米-7602128866102593818.title: Cybersecurity Engineer (Anti-Fraud & Content Security)
小米-7602128866102593818.description:
Key Responsibilities
1. Analyze security risk data and fraudulent behaviors across Xiaomi's international markets; design, validate, and deploy anti-fraud detection strategies and security controls.
2. Design, develop, and implement secure system architectures for anti-fraud and content security platforms; embed security principles into system design to mitigate risks posed by new technologies and evolving business practices.
3. Own daily content security operations for international markets: develop and tune machine-based and human-review rules and SOPs to ensure zero leakage of violative content.
4. Track the latest attack-and-defense trends in the industry, conduct threat modeling on emerging fraud vectors, and apply insights to harden detection systems and product security posture.
5. Conduct threat modeling and adversarial analysis on fraud attack vectors (e.g., account takeover, fake-account farming, transaction abuse, content manipulation); translate findings into detection logic, risk-scoring models, and preventive countermeasures.
6. Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, data, product, and legal/compliance teams to embed security and fraud-prevention controls into platform architecture and the software development lifecycle.
小米-7602128866102593818.requirements:
Requirements
1. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field; able to independently build data experiments and drive the full cycle of security strategy evaluation and deployment.
2. Experience in secure system architecture design and implementation; ability to embed security-by-design principles into enterprise platforms and services.
3. Data-driven approach; proficient in SQL/Python/Excel and capable of mobilizing cross-functional resources to implement security solutions.
4. Strong understanding of common fraud attack patterns, bot abuse, and content-evasion techniques; exceptional risk intuition and problem-solving skills to quickly identify root causes of emerging cybersecurity threats and deliver actionable security countermeasures.
5. Familiarity with security audit processes, compliance frameworks, and maintaining security documentation and standard operating procedures.
6. Ability to communicate in Mandarin and English, in order to support coordination and collaboration with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders, teams, and business partners across regional markets.

小米-7698332284324579622.title: EU Retail Training Manager
小米-7698332284324579622.description:
【Responsibilities】

1. Define and continuously evolve the retail capability and training strategy across direct, agency and partner-operated channels.
2. Design capability frameworks, role expectations, learning pathways and certification programmes for customer-facing and retail leadership roles.
3. Establish and lead the European Retail Academy, ensuring consistent onboarding, training and development across markets.
4. Develop training strategies to support new vehicle launches, systems deployments, customer journey changes and major business initiatives.
5. Own the European approach to sales, product and customer experience training, ensuring frontline teams can confidently translate Xiaomi's brand, products, technology and ecosystem capabilities into compelling customer value.
6. Build and maintain certification, recertification and compliance training programmes that reinforce operational standards and customer experience expectations.
7. Define training content requirements and learning priorities, ensuring programmes are commercially relevant, engaging and scalable across markets.
8. Personally deliver key classroom, virtual and practical training programmes, particularly during new-market launches and the initial network development phase.
9. Build effective Train-the-Trainer approaches and support the development of market and regional trainers as the European network expands.
10. Partner with Retail Design, Customer Journey, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Product and Digital teams to ensure capability programmes reflect evolving business needs.
11. Identify capability gaps through performance data, customer insights, frontline feedback and field observations, then develop targeted interventions to improve performance, productivity and customer engagement.
12. Measure training effectiveness through capability assessments, certification results, frontline performance, customer experience and relevant commercial outcomes.
13. Build and manage a future network of trainers, learning content specialists, external partners and other capability resources required to support European growth.
小米-7698332284324579622.requirements:
【What We're Looking For】

1. Significant experience leading automotive sales, product or retail training, or learning and development, ideally within an OEM, importer, dealer group or automotive consultancy.
2. A strong track record of designing and scaling training strategies, onboarding programmes, sales training, product launch training and certification models across retail or dealer networks.
3. A deep understanding of automotive retail, customer-facing sales environments and the role training plays in driving customer experience and commercial performance.
4. Strong product training capabilities, with the ability to understand vehicle technologies and translate them into relevant customer benefits rather than purely technical information.
5. Excellent facilitation, coaching and communication skills, with the credibility and confidence to personally deliver training to frontline teams and leadership audiences.
6. Previous experience in frontline automotive sales and/or automotive consultancy is highly desirable.
7. Strong programme management and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align diverse teams around common standards and objectives.
8. Confidence in using modern digital learning platforms, presentation tools and training technologies. Familiarity with creative or design tools is desirable.
9. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to link capability interventions to measurable customer, commercial and operational outcomes.
10. Excellent professional English is required. German is highly desirable, and additional European languages are an advantage.
11. Motorsport, advanced driving or track experience is desirable. A valid FIA/DMSB circuit competition licence or a recognised performance-driving instructor qualification would be an advantage.
12. Willingness to travel regularly across European markets.

小米-7685314669515753782.title: GTM Manager
小米-7685314669515753782.description:
【Key Responsibilities】

GTM Strategy & Business Planning
1. Develop Xiaomi EV’s European Go-to-Market strategy and annual business plans.
2. Define pricing, channel, and sales strategies within the Private Importer model.
3. Analyze competitive dynamics, consumer needs, market trends, and price sensitivity across European markets.
4. Translate market insights into actionable recommendations for business and commercial strategy.
5. Develop localized approaches for product configurations, color options, packages, and financing solutions based on market requirements.
Product Launch Management
1. Coordinate product launch planning and execution across European markets.
2. Align with global teams on product certification, regulatory requirements, market readiness, and localization.
3. Lead pre-launch preparation across areas such as pricing approval, channel readiness, inventory planning, and sales training.
4. Monitor market performance and customer feedback following launch and translate insights into timely business adjustments.
Sales Target & Performance Management
1. Support the development and cascade of sales targets across regions and dealer partners.
2. Establish and improve sales performance monitoring and reporting mechanisms.
3. Analyze sales performance and provide regular business insights and recommendations.
4. Monitor Private Importer and dealer performance and work with partners to support the achievement of commercial objectives.
5. Track customer leads, test-drive activity, and conversion funnels to identify opportunities for performance improvement.
Competitive Intelligence & Strategy Optimization
1. Continuously monitor competitor products, pricing, positioning, channel strategies, and market activities.
2. Develop regular competitive intelligence and market analysis reports.
3. Identify market opportunities, risks, and emerging trends and translate them into strategic recommendations.
4. Benchmark Xiaomi EV against relevant European automotive brands and identify opportunities for differentiation.
Cross-functional Collaboration
1. Work closely with Marketing, Network Development, Operations Support, and other commercial functions to establish an integrated GTM execution process.
2. Coordinate with global teams on product, pricing, supply, and other resources required for European market execution.
3. Provide management with regular GTM updates, market insights, business analysis, and strategic recommendations.
4. Drive alignment across stakeholders to ensure effective and timely execution of commercial priorities.
小米-7685314669515753782.requirements:
【Requirements】

1. 8+ years of experience in Go-to-Market, commercial strategy, sales planning, market management, or related automotive functions.
2. At least 3 years of professional experience working with European automotive markets.
3. Professional fluency in English, additional European language skills are an advantage.
4. Strong understanding of European automotive pricing, distribution/channel models, market dynamics, and consumer behavior.
5. Proven experience supporting or leading automotive product launches or market entry initiatives in Europe.
6. Strong analytical capabilities, commercial acumen, and business judgment.
7. Experience supporting the European market entry or growth of an international automotive brand is highly desirable.
8. Experience in the NEV/EV sector and a good understanding of the characteristics of electric vehicle markets is a strong advantage.
9. Strong understanding of automotive sales and distribution ecosystems across Europe.
10. Experience developing sales or commercial policies within a Private Importer, agency, dealer, or other partner-led distribution model is highly desirable.
11. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and execution capabilities.

4. Monitor market performance and customer feedback following launch and translate insights into timely business adjustments.
Sales Target & Performance Management
1. Support the development and cascade of sales targets across regions and dealer partners.
2. Establish and improve sales performance monitoring and reporting mechanisms.
3. Analyze sales performance and provide regular business insights and recommendations.
4. Monitor Private Importer and dealer performance and work with partners to support the achievement of commercial objectives.
5. Track customer leads, test-drive activity, and conversion funnels to identify opportunities for performance improvement.
Competitive Intelligence & Strategy Optimization
1. Continuously monitor competitor products, pricing, positioning, channel strategies, and market activities.
2. Develop regular competitive intelligence and market analysis reports.
3. Identify market opportunities, risks, and emerging trends and translate them into strategic recommendations.
4. Benchmark Xiaomi EV against relevant European automotive brands and identify opportunities for differentiation.
Cross-functional Collaboration
1. Work closely with Marketing, Network Development, Operations Support, and other commercial functions to establish an integrated GTM execution process.
2. Coordinate with global teams on product, pricing, supply, and other resources required for European market execution.
3. Provide management with regular GTM updates, market insights, business analysis, and strategic recommendations.
4. Drive alignment across stakeholders to ensure effective and timely execution of commercial priorities.

【Requirements】

1. 8+ years of experience in Go-to-Market, commercial strategy, sales strategy, country management or related functions.
2. At least 3 years of professional experience working with European automotive markets.
3. Professional fluency in English. German, French, Dutch are preferred.
4. Strong understanding of European automotive pricing, distribution/channel models, market dynamics, and consumer behavior.
5. Proven experience supporting or leading automotive product launches or market entry initiatives in Europe.
6. Strong analytical capabilities, commercial acumen, and business judgment.
7. Experience supporting the European market entry or growth of an international automotive brand is highly desirable.
8. Experience in the NEV/EV sector and a good understanding of the characteristics of electric vehicle markets is a strong advantage.
9. Strong understanding of automotive sales and distribution ecosystems across Europe.
10. Experience developing sales or commercial policies within a Private Importer, agency, dealer, or other partner-led distribution model is highly desirable.
11. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and execution capabilities.

小米-7707633451079649574.title: GTM Specialist/Manager – Europe
小米-7707633451079649574.description:
Product Management, Positioning & Pricing
•  Develop model and variant-level positioning, target customer profiles, value propositions and key USPs for European markets. Translate them into consistent product briefs and messages for Marketing, PR, Sales and partners.
•  Build and maintain competitive product, specification and price benchmarks; prepare pricing proposals, variant and equipment recommendations, and competitive value positioning in collaboration with Finance and Sales.
•  Support commercial planning with leasing and residual-value assumptions, and connect pricing decisions to customer value, market competitiveness and business objectives.
•  Translate customer needs, segment trends, partner feedback and European regulatory developments into feature, specification and future product proposals for HQ, with a 1–3-year outlook.
•  Support product training, press and customer-facing launch events, and collect feedback to refine the positioning after launch.

Go-to-Market & Launch Execution
•  Take part in launch planning with all European departments and HQ in Beijing; track milestones, risks and decisions through execution.
•  Lead cross-functional workstreams for specific models across launch, in-market and end-of-life phases, with clear goals, owners and follow-up.
•  Prepare product focused launch materials for press, dealer and customer-facing events.

Market & Partner Intelligence
•  Analyze European automotive markets, competitive activity, registrations and distribution structures using JATO, KBA and comparable sources.
•  Establish structured feedback loops with retail partners, distributors and internal stakeholders; convert insights into practical product, pricing and GTM recommendations.
•  Serve as a key product contact for European teams and partners on competitive benchmarking, product surveys and market-specific questions.
小米-7707633451079649574.requirements:
What You Bring

•  Proven experience in automotive product marketing, product planning, pricing or business planning at an OEM, importer or national sales company. Direct vehicle product experience is required; digital or software product experience alone does not qualify.
•  A genuine passion for cars. You can name the cars you would buy and why, you follow the segment closely, and you want to work where cars and technology meet.
•  Solid understanding of EV technology (platforms, range, charging, efficiency) and of the European market, customers and regulatory environment.
•  Strong analytical skills: you build clean benchmarks and models, and you can turn data into a recommendation.
•  Experience working across functions and with stakeholders in different regions and cultures; clear and confident communication in writing and in meetings.
•  Bachelor's degree or higher in engineering, business or a related field.
•  Fluent English, written and spoken. German and Mandarin are considered to be an advantage.

小米-7706350217896937754.title: GTM市场洞察专员-汽车国际业务
小米-7706350217896937754.description:
1、海外市场与政策研究：持续跟踪目标海外市场的宏观经济走势、产业政策、市场法规、关税及贸易壁垒，协助完成市场风险预警与应对策略输出；
2、销量数据清洗与多维分析：负责海外各市场销量大盘的数据清洗、整理与多维分析，深度剖析细分市场的容量、结构演变及未来技术与消费趋势；
3、竞品动态监测与对标：参与建立并维护核心竞品动态监测体系，从品牌定位、车型矩阵、产品配置、定价策略、渠道模式等维度开展全方位对标，寻找差异化竞争优势；
4、分析报告与决策支持：将复杂数据转化为清晰的商业观点，参与输出高质量海外市场分析报告，支持管理层完成新市场进入评估、新产品定义及销量预测等重大经营决策。
小米-7706350217896937754.requirements:
岗位要求：
1、学历与专业：本科及以上学历，统计学、数学、金融等专业，或其他工科中偏数据类的专业（如数据科学、商业分析、车辆工程等）；
2、语言与国际经历：有海外留学经历，英语可作为工作语言（读写与沟通）；
3、数据分析能力：具备优秀的数据分析能力，熟练使用 Excel、SQL、Python 等数据处理工具中至少一种；对数据敏感，能透过数据提炼业务结论；
4、沟通协作能力：优秀的沟通表达与跨团队协作能力，能清晰呈现观点、拉通信息；
5、综合素质：具备结构化逻辑思维，敢于且善于输出独立、有深度的观点；自驱力强，主动解决问题，具备抗压能力。

加分项：
1、有汽车行业、市场研究、数据分析相关实习或课题项目经历；
2、了解 S&P、JATO、MarkLines 等国际主流汽车行业数据资源；
3、有研究报告、商业分析类书面成果输出经验。

• 产品上市操盘：了解市场/客户需求，组织制定整体解决方案（包括但不限于产品、商务、营销、渠道、零售、交付、服务等），负责公司各档位产品海外市场上市操盘和生命周期管理，并进行客户互动；
• 项目管理：作为项目统筹，协同各个功能领域（包括品牌、零售、服务、交付等），组成产品上市团队，进行分层级的项目管理；
• 包装卖点及传播策略：与产品线共同牵头产品营销工作，协同品牌、零售等部门拉通在产品规划/拓展/零售等阶段的卖点包装及传播策略；
• 控货控价管理：对产品商业成功负责，通过量价管理，最大化产品收益，负责产品的发货管控与价格管控，维持市场秩序稳定；
• 产品营销费用管理：确保营销资源投入匹配产品策略，同时控制投入节奏，确保产品可持续热度，最大化投入产出；
• 跟进区域经营：对区域进行分类并指导资源分配，聚焦重点市场，指导区域市场策略，解决方案的制定，管理落地执行。

职位要求
1、本科及以上学历，5年以上手机行业GTM/销售/市场等相关经验，接受常驻海外优先。
2、责任心强，有较强的自我驱动能力和独立完成任务的能力；
3、有独立操盘手机产品上市的成功经验，或有海外相关工作经验，熟悉海外国家渠道销售策略及用户偏好；
4、具备较强的经营和统计分析能力，掌握经营分析的相关知识，熟悉IPMS全流程；
5、具有较强的内外部沟通协调及执行能力。
6、有电商平台或线上渠道操盘的相关经历可加分

小米-7667479418310953242.title: Government Relation Manager, Indonesia
小米-7667479418310953242.description:
1. Establish and maintain relationship with important government agencies / industry associations / foreign embassies / third parties. Leveraging governmental relationship to assist in permits and license application process. 
2. Arrange high-level meetings and attend public events, identify potential risks / business opportunities and advocate for the interest of Xiaomi. 
3. Tackle market access constraints, product compliance and various ad hoc corporate issues that might arise from government agencies. 
4. Engage directly with policymakers, government agencies to shape policy and political dialogue which impact Xiaomi business objective. Manage policy projects on opportunities affecting Xiaomi products area (including, user privacy, content, competition and cross industry relations). 
5. Design, implement and execute country-specific government affairs programs which tied up with government bodies key programs and interests. 
6. Collaborate cross-functionally with local business units (e.g. Products, Marketing, Public Relation, Legal) and advise on policy and political implications of product development and market operations. 
7. Be part of local crisis management team to liaison with government agencies during crisis. Lead incident response relating to government requirement, negotiate with government authorities to advocate for business priorities, and appropriately escalate when needed to drive solution.

3. Fluent interpersonal, verbal, and written skills in Bahasa and English.
4. Good network of key government body, regulatory agencies, industry organization and other stakeholders in Indonesia.
5. Proven experience of working directly with Indonesia policymakers and regulators.
6. Working knowledge of smartphone, consumer electronics and/or automotive industry and regulatory landscape is highly preferred.
7. Strategic thinker with leadership, outreach, analytical and negotiation skills.
8. Ability to manage multiple projects and to work collaboratively across different teams (internal and external) in a cross-cultural environment.
9. Ability to grasp complex technical and policy issues and communicate key messages with internal and external stakeholders. Willing to working on difficult issues and capability in solving problems creatively.

小米-7662290123224320294.title: Government Relations Manager (Automotive), Malaysia
小米-7662290123224320294.description:
This role focuses on govt and regulatory matters that are particular to Xiaomi automotive business in Malaysia. Serving as primary governmental liaison, this role will mainly involve in engaging externally and internally to support automotive business operation, including but not limited to:

1. Establish and maintain relationship with govt ministries / regulatory agencies / industry associations (in particular, MIDA, MITI, MARii, Customs, JPJ, etc). Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to advocate common industry interests and support business objectives.
2. Arrange high-level meetings and attend public events, identify potential risks / business opportunities and advocate for the interest of Xiaomi automotive business. 
3. Tackle market access constraints, product compliance and various ad hoc issues that might arise from govt agencies. Facilitate regulatory approvals and documentation.
4. Monitor, interpret, and communicate changes in govt regulations, policies, and legislation affecting the automotive industry. 
5. Coordinate internally on applications, renewals, and reporting for tax incentives, import duty exemptions, and govt incentive program, with agencies such as MIDA, MITI, MARii, Customs. 
6. Collaborate cross-functionally with internal departments and advise on policy and political implications of product development and CKD & CBU market operations. 
7. Be part of local crisis management team to liaison with govt agencies during crisis. Lead incident response relating to govt requirement, negotiate with govt authorities to advocate for business priorities, and appropriately escalate when needed to drive solution.

1. Bachelor's degree from relevant field (e.g. Politics, International Relations, Legal, Politics, etc) .
2. At least 5 years’ experience in government, and/or in govt relations, regulatory and public affairs functions within the automative industry.
3. Fluent interpersonal, verbal, and written skills in Bahasa Malaysia and English.
4. Proven understanding of Malaysia's govt policies, automotive regulatory framework, CBU & CKD operations, customs regulations, import/export procedures, and trade compliance. 
5. Experience in managing govt incentives, tax exemptions, and duty exemption applications with MIDA, MITI, MARii, Customs, JPJ, etc.
6. Strategic thinker with leadership, outreach, analytical and negotiation skills.
7. Ability to manage multiple projects and to work collaboratively across different teams (internal and external) in a cross-cultural environment.
8. Ability to grasp complex technical and policy issues and communicate key messages with internal and external stakeholders. Willing to working on difficult issues and capability in solving problems creatively.

小米-7579907650763278619.title: HMI用户体验设计
小米-7579907650763278619.description:
1.负责智能驾驶HMI的视觉呈现和交互逻辑，包括仪表盘、中控屏、HUD（抬头显示）等多屏交互设计
2.负责服务机器人的交互界面设计，包括触屏界面、语音交互、手势识别等多模态交互设计
3.进行用户研究和竞品分析，洞察用户需求和行业趋势，分析驾驶场景和机器人使用场景，设计符合场景特点的交互流程
4.制定设计规范和组件库，确保产品设计的一致性和可扩展性
小米-7579907650763278619.requirements:
教育与经验
1.本科及以上学历，工业设计、交互设计、视觉传达、人机工程等相关专业
2.三年以上HMI/UI/UX设计经验，有汽车HMI或机器人交互设计经验者优先
专业能力
1.熟练进行用户研究、任务分析、信息架构、原型设计与可用性测试
2.深刻理解交互设计原则和用户体验设计方法论，具备信息架构设计能力，能够处理复杂的信息层级和导航结构
3.精通至少一种原型/可视化工具：Figma、Axure、Principle/protopie、Unity/Unreal 等
能将感知/规划/控制数据转化为可理解可操作的 UI；
4.熟悉多模态交互设计（视觉、语音、触控、手势等），具备设计系统思维，能够构建可扩展的设计组件库
5.具备较强的逻辑思维能力和优秀的沟通表达能力，能够平衡用户需求、技术限制和商业目标并清晰阐述设计理念和方案；

小米-7694122968380623130.title: Head of PR – Europe
小米-7694122968380623130.description:
【Key Responsibilities】

European PR Strategy
1.Develop the overall European PR and communications strategy and annual PR plan, aligned with Group and headquarters communications priorities.
2.Develop market-relevant and differentiated communications narratives for Europe, taking into account the characteristics and operating models of different European markets.
3.Coordinate PR resources, activities, and communications timelines across European markets to support consistency and alignment.
European Media Relations
1.Build and maintain strong relationships with key automotive, technology, business and financial media, as well as relevant industry influencers and KOLs across Europe.
2.Plan and coordinate major European PR initiatives and events, including product launches, media drive events, industry exhibitions, and other key communications activities.
3.Oversee European media materials, interview coordination, and media and public sentiment monitoring.
Crisis Communications & Reputation Management
1.Establish crisis communications plans and response mechanisms for the European market.
2.Monitor the media and public sentiment landscape across European markets, identify potential issues at an early stage, and coordinate appropriate communications responses.
3.Coordinate communications between Xiaomi’s headquarters in China and the European organization during relevant issues or crisis situations.
Regional PR Team Management & Collaboration
1.Lead, manage, and provide guidance to regional PR functions, including Northern & Eastern Europe, Southern & Western Europe, and the UK.
2.Establish effective European PR workflows, communications asset repositories, and media databases.
3.Work closely with teams across Marketing, Network Development, GTM, and other relevant functions to ensure effective cross-functional collaboration.
Headquarters Coordination & Reporting
1.Act as a key point of contact with Xiaomi Group and international communications teams, ensuring alignment between European communications activities and the broader strategic direction of headquarters.
2.Provide regular updates to management on European PR activities, media performance, and the overall media and public sentiment landscape.
小米-7694122968380623130.requirements:
【Required Qualifications】

1.8-15 years of experience in automotive PR and communications, including at least 5 years of experience working with European markets and 3 years of team management experience.
2.Professional fluency in English. German or another European language is a plus.
3.Strong understanding of the European automotive media landscape, PR and communications environment, and relevant regulatory considerations.
4.Demonstrated experience in establishing European PR structures and processes from the ground up, or in leading PR and communications initiatives for Chinese brands entering European markets.
5.Strong crisis communications capabilities and excellent cross-cultural communication skills.

【Preferred Qualifications】

1.Experience supporting PR and communications projects for Chinese brands expanding into European markets.
2.Well-established relationships with leading automotive and technology media across Europe.
3.Experience in building or strengthening communications for new energy vehicle (NEV) brands.
4.Familiarity with EU advertising regulations, GDPR, and relevant automotive industry regulatory requirements.

小米-7664496990398777642.title: Head of Sales Planning & Analytics
小米-7664496990398777642.description:
The Head of Sales Planning & Analytics is responsible for commercial planning, performance intelligence and data-driven decision-making across Xiaomi Auto Europe.
The role provides a single source of truth for commercial performance by combining internal sales and customer data with external market, competitor and channel intelligence to understand what is happening, why it is happening and what actions the business should take.
The role owns sales forecasting, target and inventory planning, performance diagnosis, scenario modelling and commercial programme planning. It partners closely with GTM to translate broader market, product and customer intelligence into commercial implications and actionable recommendations.
The role enables leaders to anticipate opportunities and risks, optimise commercial performance and make informed decisions across markets, channels, products and the customer journey.

【Responsibilities】

1. Own commercial performance intelligence across Europe, combining sales, funnel, customer, channel and external market data to provide a holistic view of business performance and its underlying drivers.
2. Develop commercial market intelligence, partnering with GTM to assess market development, customer and EV trends, competitor performance, pricing movements and external factors, translating these into commercial implications for Xiaomi.
3.Own sales planning and forecasting, including demand planning, target setting, inventory planning, reforecasting and launch volume scenarios across markets and products.
4. Lead sales performance diagnosis and channel benchmarking, identifying why performance is ahead of or behind plan and opportunities to improve conversion, productivity and performance across direct, partner and digital channels.
5. Own commercial measurement and reporting, establishing consistent KPIs, data governance, dashboards and executive insights that explain what happened, why it happened, what is likely to happen next and what actions are recommended.
6. Lead commercial scenario modelling and business cases, assessing the impact of changes in demand, volume, pricing, conversion, inventory and commercial interventions to support strategic decision-making.
7. Lead commercial proposition and sales programme planning, including finance and leasing, trade-in, launch programmes, tactical activation and volume- or inventory-led interventions within agreed GTM strategic guardrails.
8.Measure and optimise commercial effectiveness, evaluating programme performance and ROI, identifying risks and opportunities, and partnering with GTM and market teams to recommend actions throughout the vehicle lifecycle.
小米-7664496990398777642.requirements:
【What We're Looking For】

1. Proven experience in sales planning or business analytics within the automotive, retail or other complex multi-channel businesses.
2. Strong track record in developing forecasting models, performance reporting, business planning processes and executive dashboards.
3. Advanced analytical skills, with experience translating complex data into clear commercial insights and strategic recommendations.
4. Experience working with CRM, BI and reporting platforms, with a strong understanding of data governance and performance measurement principles.
5. Excellent commercial acumen, with the ability to balance customer and operational performance.
6. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience influencing senior leaders through data and insight.
7. Highly organised, with strong problem-solving capabilities and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

小米-7677932901602461979.title: IFS解决方案专家
小米-7677932901602461979.description:
1. 变革方案设计：主导集团IFS财经数字化变革，结合3C、汽车业态特点，搭建核算、资金、预算、费控、财报等全场景数字化解决方案，输出可落地的顶层设计与实施规范
2. 多业态业财融合：吃透3C、智能汽车业务全链路，梳理供应链、产销、渠道、售后业财痛点，打通业务与财务数据壁垒，搭建适配多业态发展的一体化财经体系
3. 跨方协同落地：牵头业务、财务、IT、供应商多方团队，统筹需求调研、方案评审、进度管控、问题攻坚，协调资源、统一共识，保障项目按期高质量交付
4. 体系迭代沉淀：跟进项目全流程落地、上线与运维，持续优化方案、流程与数据标准，沉淀IFS变革方法论，搭建集团财经数字化标准体系
5. 项目结果攻坚：以结果为导向，主动预判、解决项目风险与重难点，全权负责项目闭环，实现财经降本、提效、控险、提质目标
6. 数字化创新升级：跟踪行业财经数字化、IFS迭代前沿趋势，结合集团战略引入先进方案，持续赋能财经体系升级
小米-7677932901602461979.requirements:
1. 本科及以上学历，8年以上大型集团财务数字化、IFS/ERP实施、业财解决方案相关经验，具备大厂高级经理/总监级能力，有大型财经变革项目主导经验
2. 深度主导或核心参与过大型企业IFS财务数字化变革项目，熟悉IFS系统架构、财务核心模块，完整经历方案设计、多方协同、落地上线全流程
3. 精通财务与数字化双领域，熟悉全链路财务业务，掌握业财一体化、数据治理、系统架构及方案设计逻辑
4. 熟悉智能汽车、3C消费电子任意一类业态商业模式、供应链及业财痛点，具备多业态业财方案设计能力
5. 具备优秀的顶层规划、需求拆解能力，可独立输出高质量、高落地性的数字化解决方案与实施报告
6. 擅长跨部门沟通、资源整合与博弈推进，可高效推动多方共识与项目落地
7. 逻辑清晰、具备全局视野，擅长复杂项目统筹管控，具备中高层汇报能力
8. 理解SAP整体产品体系、财务模块架构与业财逻辑，熟悉SAP与业财中台的差异、适配场景及集成逻辑，能够结合不同系统体系设计适配的数字化变革方案

小米-7671226143408425279.description:
1. 负责公司级IPD平台建设项目的整体规划与落地，牵引需求调研、流程梳理、方案设计、项目实施、上线验收及持续优化。
2. 协同产品、软件研发、硬件研发、测试、质量、供应链、财务、IT等部门，推动需求管理、产品规划、项目立项、阶段评审、软硬件开发验证、发布上市等IPD关键流程线上化、标准化和数据化。
3. 管理项目范围、进度、风险、资源和交付质量，推动跨部门问题闭环，并建设平台运营机制、数据看板和流程改进方法论。
【岗位亮点】
1. 参与公司级IPD平台和研发管理数字化体系建设，岗位影响范围大。
2. 深度连接产品、软件、硬件、测试、质量、供应链、财务和IT等核心部门，业务视野全面。
3. 直接推动软硬件研发流程标准化、项目管理透明化和经营决策数据化。
小米-7671226143408425279.requirements:
1. 本科及以上学历，5年以上项目管理、研发管理、流程数字化、PLM/PPM/IPD平台建设或企业级系统实施经验，其中至少2年以上IPD、软硬件研发项目管理或研发管理数字化相关项目经验。
2. 熟悉IPD流程体系和端到端产品开发流程，理解软件、硬件、测试、质量、供应链等研发协同场景，具备较强的业务流程梳理、方案设计、系统需求转化和数据指标建设能力。
3. 具备大型复杂项目独立推进能力，能够协调产品、软件、硬件、测试、质量、供应链、IT等多部门、多层级、多系统资源，具备良好的管理层沟通汇报、风险管控和结果交付能力。
【加分项】
1. 有制造业、高科技、硬件、汽车、医疗器械、通信、半导体、新能源、智能装备等行业软硬件产品研发管理平台建设经验。
2. 有IPD体系导入、软硬件研发流程变革、产品开发管理体系建设或大型企业数字化转型经验。
3. 熟悉产品组合管理、需求池管理、阶段门评审、软硬件协同开发、研发资源管理、项目成本管理、质量问题闭环、技术评审等场景。
4. 有从0到1建设IPD平台、PLM平台、PPM平台或研发管理平台的经验。
5. 持有PMP、NPDP、ACP、PRINCE2、信息系统项目管理师等证书优先。
